manifest.required_content: model_type=dpcrn_streaming_frame; processor=stft_frame_ort; sample_rate=16000; fft_length=512; win_length=512; hop_length=160; streaming_delay_frames=3

reopen_condition: Reopen asset identity only when the exact dpcrn_mamba_v1.onnx and dpcrn_mamba_v1.json bytes are addressed by an immutable model artifact revision plus byte count and SHA-256 in a retrieval record, the manifest fields are verified, and both resolve from the caller's own storage without a provider file access or download. Reopen runtime admission only when a pinned puresound-streaming 0.1.0 wheel or sdist with a recorded digest and a pinned onnxruntime 1.24.1 install in an approved isolated environment, the adapter runs under the requirements lock, and a recorded parity run on the frozen inputs succeeds.

rights.model_license: Apache-2.0 (official NOTICE); third-party material and datasets excluded
rights.training_data_note: release notes cite VCTK-DEMAND and DNS-5 evaluation and DNS-style training, but the pinned ledger does not establish exact corpus exposure or third-party dataset terms
